evals.prompt: Run adversarial browser QA on my React task app at localhost:5173. Cover create, edit, complete, and delete, fix failures, and retest.
evals.expected_output: Detects the stack, exercises the requested workflows with Playwright, applies scoped functional fixes, re-runs failures, and writes a workspace QA report with evidence.
expectations: Tests the four requested task workflows
Captures browser, console, and network failure evidence
Writes WORKSPACE/qa-report.md with screenshot paths and unresolved external dependencies

evals.prompt: Check the mobile checkout flow at localhost:5173/checkout in standard mode. Focus on multi-step state, validation, and broken navigation.
evals.expected_output: Scopes testing to checkout, covers desktop and mobile browser states, attacks multi-step state transitions, and reports verified fixes.
expectations: Scopes the workflow checklist to checkout
Uses Playwright at mobile and desktop sizes
Tests validation, back/forward navigation, and repeat submission
Writes a QA report and final pass count

evals.prompt: Run frontend-twerkin on my Expo habit app in the iOS simulator. Test rotation, background/resume, streak updates, and settings.
evals.expected_output: Detects native Expo, loads the native guide, uses existing native tooling for native behavior, and does not claim Expo web proves iOS behavior.
expectations: Detects React Native or Expo and reads references/native-testing.md
Uses existing Detox or simulator tooling for native behavior
Tests rotation, background/resume, streak updates, and settings
Separates native evidence from any Expo web checks

evals.prompt: Run my pytest suite and show me which unit tests fail.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke frontend-twerkin; runs the unit-test command directly.
expectations: Does not start a frontend server or Playwright
Does not enter a browser fix loop
Runs pytest directly or explains the direct test command
